# Warfarin (test fixture)

Short synthetic document used only by the unit tests.

## Indications and Usage

Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis.

## Contraindications

- Pregnancy, except in women with mechanical heart valves.
- Hemorrhagic tendencies or blood dyscrasias.
- Malignant hypertension.

## Drug Interactions

SSRIs such as sertraline increase bleeding risk. Monitor INR more frequently.
